'''Mor Akrav''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Sith Saber]] who was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Akrav was part of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] infiltration team that took up residence in the newly abandoned [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], under orders of [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]]. He and his fellow Sith were killed by [[Tesar Sebatyne]] and the other Barabel Jedi who had volunteered to stay behind and guard the Temple.
